name: NewMeter and TinyMeter
notes: The captured NewMeter 1.439 archive supplies the five exact catalogs and five translation sources. Both shipped 1.431 executable copies use checked BCWB inputs while their original archive remains open.
Tinic Urou's Aminet release supplies the exact TinyMeter V4.31 executable, three patterns and 184 pictograms. The checked BCWB profile and icon preserve the dormant Enable layout.

The checked BCWB NewMeter icons and Tooltypes document preserve the release-specific Workbench configuration. Only WBStartup/NewMeter starts with Workbench. Its 4096-byte stack, DONOTWAIT, IDLETASK, NOVOL=#? and empty WIFIDEVICE are stored in the stock startup icon.
The shared Expansion and WBStartup drawers and the startup scripts retain their existing ownership.
